amendment_reason: The Step-0 probe crashed with an IMPLEMENTATION error before any fit or prediction: scripts/run_sol_tabpfn.py create_model(..., icl_bf16=True, ...) calls models[0].enable_icl_bf16(), which exists only on the v3.5 model class. The TabPFN-2.6 class TabPFNV2p6 exposes no precision-switch API at all (introspection: no enable_*/set_* precision members; only get_supported_kv_cache_precisions). This is an architecture capability difference, not a tuning choice, and no predictive result exists for this checkpoint.

delta.icl_bf16: v3.5-only ICL bf16 switch: DISABLED (unavailable on TabPFNV2p6); the model runs its ICL forward in its native precision under inference_precision='autocast'

consequence_disclosed: Without the bf16 ICL switch the inference path carries more memory than the champion's, so the full 559,708-row context fit may hit the same wall that closed FLM12 (TabPFN-2.5). If it OOMs, the ALREADY-PREREGISTERED single amendment applies: context = stratified 100,000 rows from FIT, batch 1024, everything else identical. Any downstream claim about this candidate must disclose the context bound; it is NOT directly comparable to a full-context champion member.
frozen_metrics_unchanged: port_delta_v7 (equal-logit blend with the true v7)
scientific_claim_if_promoted: A context-bounded TabPFN-2.6 member may only be promoted on the strength of its own 5-fold paired comparison against v7, with the context bound stated in every report. It is not a drop-in replacement for a full-context v3.5 member.
